program.name: Fighter Flow 35
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Bouts, then Tabatas or strength, and a mobility flow to close, with no gear.
program.about: Fight training that leaves you looser than it found you. Each day opens with bouts; then Tabatas and a hip flow one day, bodyweight strength and a shoulder and spine flow the next. They alternate. No abs finisher, since the flow closes the session. Both later levels add reps.
program.split: Bouts, Tabatas & hip flow / bouts, strength & shoulder flow
